topic: Flight testing of naval aircraft, Maintenance Test Flight, Check Test Flight and documentation.
syllabus_extract: Flight testing of naval aircraft, Maintenance Test Flight, Check Test Flight and documentation.
specific_objectives: 1.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to understand modification, life categories and flight-testing effect of CG variation and wartime maintenance procedure.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of flight test logs and maintenance test flight checklists; Instructor supervision of document verification procedures.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a maintenance test flight?
Define the difference between a check test flight and a maintenance test flight.
Why is documentation critical during wartime maintenance procedures?

development.content:
Flight testing of naval aircraft
Modification and life categories
CG variation flight-testing effects
Wartime maintenance procedures

Maintenance Test Flight procedures
Check Test Flight requirements
Documentation standards and forms

topics: Integration of CG data in test flights
development.content:
Integration of CG data in test flights
Reporting deviations during testing
Post-flight documentation review

summary_questions: Explain how CG variation affects flight testing outcomes.
Describe the key documentation required for a Check Test Flight.
Identify two critical steps in wartime maintenance flight procedures.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the documentation requirements for a Maintenance Test Flight to be used in the next lesson on aircraft loading and CG determination.
